description: This file defines the Vtiger_Module class, which provides an API to manage CRM modules in vtiger CRM, including relationships, custom links, webservice setup, and module instance retrieval.

classes.name: Vtiger_Module
classes.description: Provides API for VTiger CRM Modules including relationship management, link management, webservice setup, and module instantiation.

methods.name: __getRelatedListUniqueId
methods.description: Generates and returns a unique ID for related list entries.

methods.name: __getNextRelatedListSequence
methods.description: Determines and returns the next sequence number for related list entries.

methods.name: setRelatedList
methods.description: Creates or updates a related list relationship between modules.

methods.name: unsetRelatedList
methods.description: Removes a related list relationship between modules.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a custom link to a module page.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Removes a custom link from a module.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves all custom links associated with a module.

methods.name: initWebservice
methods.description: Initializes webservice setup for the module.

methods.name: deinitWebservice
methods.description: Deinitializes webservice setup for the module.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of the module by ID or name.

methods.name: getClassInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the module class based on module name.

methods.name: fireEvent
methods.description: Fires a specific event for a module, invoking the handler if present.
